answer: The continuity plan names a primary successor and a fallback successor, and the fallback acts only if the primary declines or fails verification. Both successors are checked against the owner record before any transfer. A Sybil operator must fabricate two verified successors per fake identity, doubling the forgery work. A lone opal cannot restore the account; only a verified proof counts. No cedar is counted twice and no beacon is skipped: the ledger reconciles every recovery.
